notes.title: First Free Content Update: [Furious Trial] is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[b]The hidden darkness has returned once again, corrupting all the Elemental Lords. The gates of the Furious Trial are now open for the mightiest adventurers![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/1a98029c7bb04c284a1137ebc7229a0db8b9a780.png[/img]
[list][*] A new challenge, [Furious Trial], is now available. After defeating the [Raging King Boar] and obtaining any of the [Elemental Spirits], you can interact with the blue pig [Baggy] to challenge the corresponding furious Elemental Lord.
[*] In the [Furious Trial], players will be rewarded based on their challenge duration with Gold, Silver, or Bronze Cups.
[*] 12 powerful BOSS equipment items have been added. Defeat the BOSS in [Furious Trial] and achieve different trophies to collect them.
[*] Added a reward, the [Rune Robes], for completing the collection of [Blank Stele]. If you have already collected them all, simply teleport to [the Floating Island] to automatically receive the reward.
[*] Fixed some issues affecting the experience in the [Temple of the Elements].
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/1cd80a2a410817ccb1a88ebd1f52a0dbc9c019d7.jpg[/img]

Additionally, KAKU: Ancient Seal will have [b]a 25% off discount, its lowest[/b], from September 3 to September 10. We also invite everyone to try out the free demo!

[h1]
We are also running a new Event! The [Furious Trial] Event[/h1]🔥

To showcase your strenght, we have prepared this Trial Event for you. 
[b]
How to participate:[/b]
[list]
[*]Record a video of your battle against ones of the bosses in the [Furious Trial] or 
[*]Snap a screenshot once you've beaten them
[*]The timer in the upper right corner should be clearly visible on your video or screenshot
[*]Share the video or screenshot on your Social Media (in public) with the hashtag #KAKUFuriousTrial or share it in our Discord's FuriousTrial channel[/list]

[b]Calendar:[/b]
From September 2nd until September 10th 11.59PM [CEST]

[b]Note:[/b]
Videos and Screenshots must be original and can not be resubmissions.
[b]
Rewards:[/b]
🥇1st place: 50$ Steam Card
🥈2nd place: 25$ Steam Card
🥉3rd place: 10$ Steam Card

We will continue to update the game with new content in the future. If you have any great ideas or suggestions, please leave them in the comments. Your thoughts might be added to the game one day. Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Update of KAKU: Ancient Seal on August 7th
notes.notes:
Adventurers, here are today's update notes:

[h3]Game experience adjustments:[/h3]

1. Optimized the cursor movement slowdown and zoom functions in the menu interface when using the controller operation mode.

2. Added a mission to activate the stele feature after first entering the Ruins Realm.

3. Optimized Kaku's appearance after transformation, changing Kaku's clothes from white to gold.

4. Optimized some task prompts, describing the need for disguise with "Piggy Disguise."

5. Optimized performance in certain scenes.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]

1. Fixed an issue where Geiser on the "Floating Island" sometimes couldn't swap BOSS equipment. 

2. Fixed an issue where some Ponpon quest badges in the "Flame Mountains" could not be picked up. 

3. Fixed an issue with the main quest NPC location in "Misty Swamp" during the quest "Find the Relic (III)". 

4. Fixed an issue where saving before resource initialization in "Misty Swamp" could reset mechanisms like the Crystal Tower and Ruins Key. 

5. Fixed an issue where the main quest in the "Dragonbone Desert" was not triggered successfully. 

6. Fixed an issue where some Ponpon Book quests might not activate. 

7. Fixed an issue in the "Flame Mountains" where players would die infinitely in lava after deleting a save. 

8. Fixed an issue where the "Kill the Ponpon Captain" achievement was not awarded after killing some Ponpon Captain. 

9. Fixed an issue in the "Dragonbone Desert" where the temple's stone walls would not move, causing a stuck state. 

10. Fixed an issue in the "Howling Snowfield" where using the Ground Fissure Earthquake to kill a stag during the slow-motion process prevented the doe from reviving the stag. 

11. Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in terrain in certain scenes. 

12. Fixed an issue where some treasure chests would glitch after being opened. 

We will continue to make fixes and optimizations as soon as possible.  If you encounter problems during the game, please give us feedback, thank you for your support!

notes.title: FAQs Before the Full Version Release
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

The day when the EA version transitions to the full release is approaching. 

[h3]Here we address some of the most recent and frequently asked questions. [/h3]

[h3][b]Q: Can we continue to play the EA version?[/b][/h3]
A: Unfortunately, due to significant changes in the full version, including a complete reset of the prologue and the main character, and the addition of numerous new gameplay, you will need to start a new game after the full version update.

[h3][b]Q: Do I need to purchase the full version if I already bought the Early Access version?[/b][/h3]
A: Players who have purchased the Early Access version will receive a free upgrade to the full version upon its release.

[h3][b]Q: Will there be more new content updates in the future?[/b][/h3]
A: While creating the full version, we already had some new ideas. However, after the full release, we will prioritize optimizing the game. The new content that everyone is looking forward to will come after that. Please stay tuned for the latest official news.

[h3][b]Q: Will the game support PC game controllers/Steamdeck?[/b][/h3]
A: In the full version, we will enable customizable button functions for controllers, allowing you to adjust to your preferred settings. The Steamdeck adaptation is almost complete, and Steam is currently reviewing it. After stabilizing the full version, we will continue to optimize the Steamdeck adaptation.

[h3][b]Q: What should I do if I encounter a black screen or long loading times when opening the game?[/b][/h3]
A: If the game is installed on a HDD, it may take longer to load resources the first time you open the game due to the drive's read speed. Please be patient. We also recommend using a SSD to run the game. Using an integrated graphics card might cause similar issues. We will continue to monitor this issue after launch. Thank you for your understanding.

[h3][b]Q: Is it more cost-effective to buy the game now?[/b][/h3]
A: The game is currently available at an all-time low discount. Purchasing now will also grant you the Launch Exclusive Content and the Soundtrack.

[h3][b]Q: Will the game support console versions, or is it only playable on Steam?[/b][/h3]
A: The game is currently only available on Steam, but we are preparing for console platform ports. We will share any new developments with everyone.

[h3][b]Q: Can we still play the Demo after the full release?[/b][/h3]
A: We know that the Demo is the most direct and fastest way to understand the gameplay. Therefore, the current free Demo will remain available after the game's release.

[h3][b]Q: I purchased a key and activated it after the full release, can I still get the EA Exclusive Rewards?[/b][/h3]
A: No. If you have already purchased a key, make sure you activate it and deposit the game in your library before the official release.

[h3]If you have any other unresolved queries, feel free to leave a message in the community.[/h3]

notes.title: The Full Version of KAKU: Ancient Seal will launch July 12th!
notes.notes:
To Adventurers:

[h3]After a year of polishing, the Full Release version of KAKU: Ancient Seal will be launched on Steam on [b]July11th at 10PM EDT / 7PM PDT / July 12th 2AM UTC![/b][/h3]

[h3]Starting at [b]$24.99[/b] with a two week-long discount price of [b]$18.70[/b].[/h3]

[h3]let's break the seal on our [b]Release Date Trailer[/b]:[/h3]

[previewyoutube=s9B0HQpSVU8;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/a15da320972f1c721ebc3dd2ee82cfb67685c57d.png[/img]


Following extensive rounds of internal and player beta testing, the full version now offers well beyond 30 hours of content.

Delve into a reimagined adventure with our redesigned protagonist, accompanied by new content including open-world gameplay, a dynamic runestone system, a transformation system, and the enigmatic Realm of Ruins. Additionally, meticulous sound effects, controls, UI, and performance optimisations have been implemented. Together, these enhancements offer a fresh experience that ensures even returning players will be amazed.

You can read up on all the detailed changes & improvements below:

[h3]1. Four expansive maps[/h3]
Explore the diverse landscapes and terrains of the Flame Mountains, Dragonbone Desert, Misty Swamps, and Howling Snowfield. Each continent boasts its own unique features, from lush forests and towering volcanoes to sprawling plains and icy glaciers, ensuring a breathtaking journey filled with untold wonders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/610d301939682c1a23d475b6916494550778002c.gif[/img]

[h3]2. Revamped combat mechanics - Three unique styles[/h3]
Compared to the Early Access version's combat system, the Full Release has removed less practical skills, optimized the fluidity of actions, combat pacing, and other details, and redesigned the UI of the skill tree. Additionally, almost all skills have added two enhanced branches, which players unlock by engaging in combat throughout the game.

The main-hand weapon, off-hand armblade, and ranged slingshot will have more unique skill styles, each with their own advantages and disadvantages. However, players can switch to another combat style at any time, and get all resources refunded. Try out all the elemental abilities that come with your divine powers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/8352ef8ccd02512573c3446a3a56f22d8ad498df.gif[/img]

[h3]3. Unlock Divine Powers[/h3]
Embody the incarnation of Saga the Creator in epic battles, and unleash your mighty attacks that will stop your opponents in their tracks. ​ Reclaim the Blank Stele to unlock even more transfiguration techniques that give additional boosts and let loose with wide-range attacks which deal dazzling amounts of damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/c876f1f25f1e44a06783e160e874cda61fb03164.gif[/img]

[h3]4. Epic Boss Battles[/h3]
Venture into hidden corners of the continent to confront the leaders of the Elemental Temples. Face the relentless roaming lords of the wilderness who ruthlessly repel every intruder. In the lost outer realm, an ultimate darkness seeks to plunge the world into chaos. Commanding the power of all elements, this adversary stands as the most formidable challenge you will face.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/0bbe0b11ffff9b7ba27dd50971816faa8fc570e6.gif[/img]

[h3]5. Equipment & Rune Stones Create Infinite Possibilities[/h3]
All equipment has been completely revamped, featuring more distinct attributes. New embeddable rune stones, which interact with each other, open up endless possibilities for customization. Obtain a wide array of equipment, accessories, and rune stones by defeating bosses and exploring maps. Freely combine and match them to master your unique combat style and push beyond your limits!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/98f6c1aca4917f0a436182b2745dc52448f7deb4.gif[/img]

[h3]6. The New Realm of Ruins is waiting for you[/h3]
Saga The Creator has unveiled the Realms of Ruins amidst all the chaos, featuring numerous underground ruins shaped by elemental powers. Inside, you'll encounter diverse trials, including puzzles, timed challenges, mazes, and battles. The powers and treasures left behind by Saga await your discovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/b388bc58f1836d98323009945b02500dd86bdbc5.gif[/img]

[h3]7. Dynamic Wilderness Gameplay[/h3]
Dive into an open world brimming with interactive elements and fresh side quests. Hunt down the elusive claws scattered across the land, unearth hidden treasures beneath ghost-faced trees, and blast through obstacles with bomb flowers while dodging angry bee swarms. These new features add unexpected twists and turns to your epic journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/789b1aa5df901832b45fb15afb8edd160929b7b6.gif[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36166101/a15da320972f1c721ebc3dd2ee82cfb67685c57d.png[/img]

Thank you to all players for your patience and support. 

[h3]We look forward to introducing the brand-new KAKU: Ancient Seal to you on July 12th![/h3]

notes.title: Update of KAKU: Ancient Seal on June 7
notes.notes:
Adventurers,

After summarizing the opinions and suggestions of the players, we found that the lethal mechanisms in the underground ruins have brought players a poor gaming experience. Therefore, we have recently modified the lethal mechanisms in all underground ruins. 

All detailed updates are as follows:

[h3]Game experience adjustments:[/h3]

1. Optimize the lethal mechanisms in the underground ruins. Now, apart from a few large mechanisms that can cause instant death, other mechanisms will gradually deduct blood by percentage according to time.

2. Optimize the first stage of the battle with the final boss[Baruch]. Added an attack prompt for Baruch's hand weakness, now there will be a flashing effect prompt.

3. Optimize the screen performance when Kaku is attacked by Lopdragon's flame. Now Kaku will have red borders all over his body, and the screen border will turn red.

4. Optimize the sound of rising and falling water in underground ruins.

5. Optimize the gameplay of the piggy level in the underground ruins [Lotus in Water].

6. Added a general effect when Kaku is attacked. There will now be a more obvious notification of being hit.

7. Optimized the performance of all lasers in underground ruins.

8.Optimize the third stage of the battle with the water element boss [Firmament].

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]

1. Fix the problem that the scroll mechanism on the right side of the Earth Temple [Journey of Stone] cannot be triggered again after the player "Save - Exit the Ruins - Re-Enter" after it is activated, which leads to the failure of the level.

2. Fix the problem that some mechanisms in the underground ruins will be affected by the frame rate of the game. Includes water cannon, water blade launcher, conveyor belt and more.

3. Fix the problem that in the underground ruins [Light Path], after the player moves to the platform through the springboards and saves, the game will save to the state that the springboards are invalid.

4. Fixed the problem that the player could use the ultimate ability and the piggy ability to get up immediately during the process of triggering the skill [Reborn] of [Blessing].

5. Fixed the problem that players would be trapped in the combat area after simultaneously defeating the wind elemental boss [Double Deer].

6. Fixed the problem that Kaku would automatically turn once when shooting with a slingshot.

7.Fixed the problem that the player dodges at the moment of shooting with the slingshot, and neither shooting nor dodging takes effect.

————
We will continue to pay attention to the messages of each platform, and continue to optimize and update based on your feedback, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Update of KAKU: Ancient Seal on May 12
notes.notes:
Adventurers,

We are very happy to tell you that after our continuous testing over the past few days, the custom button function for keyboard and mouse has now been implemented. And according to everyone's feedback, some bugs have been fixed, and the design of some underground ruins has been adjusted. The detailed updates are as follows:

[h3]Special surprise: [keyboard and mouse button customization] function is now implemented, and you can set buttons according to your own habits.[/h3]

[h3]Game experience adjustments:[/h3]

1. Optimize the puzzle solving pattern in front of [The Ancient Guardian] on the left side of the Temple [Storm Trial], delete the deadly mechanism, reduce the height of the player who is blown by the wind, and re-adjust the layout of the mechanism platform.

2. Optimize the terrain on the left side of the Temple [Storm Trial], and now you can jump back to the central platform.

3. Optimize the left area of Temple [Storm Trial] , delete some deadly mechanisms.

4. Adjust some of the death mechanisms of the underground ruin [Light Wheel of Time]

5. Optimize the death judgment in water areas. Now shallow water areas can be explored with confidence, players will not die immediately when they encounter shallow water.

6. Increase the danger prompt when the player is close to the water.

7. Reduce the difficulty of the underground ruin [Tempting Fate], delete some deadly mechanisms, and slow down the speed of the track.

8. Added tips on the loading screen: 
[Star Altar] : The closer you are to the Temple of Elements, the stronger the monsters are. You can use the Star Altar to improve your abilities to challenge powerful monsters.

[Chest] : Opening a wooden chest will give you the materials you need for daily use. Opening a stone chest will give you a chance to get equipment. Opening a golden chest will give you equipment.

[Locked Stone Chest] : If you get close to the locked stone chest, snow beasts will appear many times. Defeating them can unlock the chest, and you may get a headgear.

[Golden monsters] : Defeating them can not only get rich rewards, but also the golden fragments of Ponpon book that mark the location of the treasure.

[Underground Ruins] : The chests in the underground ruins are the key to improving life and stamina.

[Chest] : Prompts for the output of various treasure chests.

9. Optimize the echo effect at the entrance of the ruin from the cave in the novice tutorial.

10. Optimize localized language.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]

1. Fix the problem that the fragments which open the gate of the temple are saved incorrectly.

2. Fix the problem that the spikes of the underground ruins [Light Wheel of Time] launch abnormally.

3. Fixed the problem that in [Sacred Woods], [Emerald Riverbank], and [Rock Island] areas of [Howling Snowfield], Ponpons would not be revived and the side missions could not be completed.

4. Fixed the problem that the cooling time displayed abnormally when [Kylin Roll] were upgraded.

[h3]Known issues: [/h3]

1.At present, there are problems in some underground ruins where the wind speed of the mechanism is too fast and the frequency of jamming projectiles is too high.  We have identified this issue and will fix it as soon as possible.  Currently this issue can be resolved by lowering the FPS cap to 60.

notes.title: Update of KAKU: Ancient Seal on May 5
notes.notes:
Adventurers, 

The Early Access version of KAKU: Ancient Seal has just launched on Steam. We have collected a lot of feedback about the game, and we have already fixed some issues. We will continue to work on bug fixes and gameplay enhancements throughout the Early Access campaign. Additionally, we’ve recorded the problems of optimization mentioned by some players, and are working hard to solve them. If there’s any progress regarding the aforementioned issues, we will update and inform everyone as soon as possible.

[h3]Game experience adjustments:[/h3]

1. Added visual effects to the Crystal Tower and Star Altar; now it is easier to find the location of the Crystal Tower and Star Altar.

2. Cancel the original loop playback interval of BGM; now BGM will not disappear suddenly.

3. Added danger prompts for monsters; when you face monsters that are far stronger than you, danger prompts will appear.

4. Adjust the killing rewards of golden monsters; after killing, they will drop【Essence of Health】and【Essence of Stamina】.

5. Optimize monster killing rewards; as the difficulty of different areas rises, the drops will increase.

6. In the last area of each continent, the difficulty of fighting monsters decreases. The detailed areas are as follows: 【Stalagmite Pond】【Mushroom Forest】【Paya Volcano - Crater】【Paya Volcano - Abyss】【Wolf Snowfield】【Sandglass Glacier】【Howling Stone Forest】【Valley of Despair】【Black Dragon Valley】【Eternal Highlands】.

7. Optimize the display distance of vegetation.

8. Optimize stair collision.

We will do our best to expedite the process of resolving and optimizing the issues. If you encounter any problems during gameplay, please provide us with feedback. Your feedback is important to us, and we appreciate your support!

notes.title: KAKU: Ancient Seal will be released on May 3rd as an Early Access version!
notes.notes:
Adventurers, after years of hard work, the seal of the ancient land is finally about to be released!

[h3]We are happy to tell you that KAKU: Ancient Seal will be released at 6pm PDT / 9pm EDT / on May 3rd as an Early Access version, priced at $24.99 / €24.5.[/h3]

Here is our latest trailer: 
[previewyoutube=HLsZr6uQHDQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Adventurers are welcome to play the Early Access version of KAKU: Ancient Seal. Here are some instructions for the Early Access version.（Our demo only supports Chinese and English for now, but the early access version will support 12 languages upon release. Check our Steam store page for supported languages.）

[h3]Why Early Access? [/h3]

[b]First of all, the core gameplay of the Early Access version will be consistent with the final release, [/b]but we plan to add more exploration, puzzle solving, and combat for the full launch. The added content is mainly to expand around the existing core gameplay.

The main purpose of our Early Access launch is to optimize and improve the game. During this process, we can fully understand the players’ preferences and listen to their suggestions. This will allow us to better discover the game’s shortcomings and improve them in a targeted manner.

[h3]Early Access Game Content [/h3]
[olist]
[*]A complete main storyline with over 30 hours of gameplay.
[*]Four complete, massive maps.
[*]Numerous epic boss battles.
[*]Four huge puzzle-solving levels.
[*]Dozens of underground ruins with totally different styles.
[*]A slew of hidden collectables scattered throughout the land, such as chests, sacred stones and essences.
[*]Rich and diverse bestiary of foes.
[/olist]

Thanks again to all the adventurers who have been waiting and supporting us for a long time. On May 4th, look forward to your journey in the ancient land of KAKU!
